prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Compact upload layout redesign with photo preview: Redesign the upload_photos screen into a compact layout with a live photo preview container to help users upload high quality pet photos easily.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"layout": "compact", "headline": "Upload Your Pet Photos", "body": "Add photos of your pet to help generate your custom companion.", "components": [{"type": "preview", "style": "rounded"}]}}
1: [finish, new_screen] Companion mascot greeting screen before desktop reveal: Insert a new companion greeting screen right before home_intro to introduce the pet's character.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_pet_greeting", "home_intro"], "new_pet_greeting": {"headline": "Your Desktop Companion is Ready!", "body": "Your new pet is eager to join you on your screen.", "layout": "centered", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "style": "playful"}]}}
2: [choose_path, redesign] Story scroll intro redesign: Redesign the initial story screen using a story_scroll layout featuring option preview cards before path selection.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "story_scroll", "headline": "Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Discover how you can adopt or build your custom digital friend.", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "style": "rounded"}]}}
3: [home, new_flow] Generation wait flow video preview: Enhance the waiting screen with a video asset preview showing what the pet can do on the desktop while generation completes.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "notify_when_ready": true, "components": [{"type": "video", "asset": "asset:generation_preview", "style": "rounded"}]}}
4: [sign_in, copy] Account pet safety copy on sign-in screen: Update headline and body on sign_in to explicitly explain that signing in backs up the pet and prevents progress loss.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign In to Save Your Pet", "body": "Linking your account ensures your pet and accessories are backed up permanently.", "button_label": "Continue to Save Pet"}}
5: [adoption, wait_info] Adoption certificate progress tracking info: Enable progress bars and step counters on the adoption certificate screen to clarify adoption status.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"show_progress": true, "show_step_counter": true, "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Adoption Verified", "style": "highlight"}]}}
6: [finish, hint] Desktop pet control interactions hint: Add an explicit interactive hint on home_intro explaining how to click, drag, hide, or talk to the pet on desktop.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "card", "hint": "Click your pet on the screen anytime to chat, drag to move, or right-click to minimize."}}
7: [choose_path, incentive] Path selection feature badges: Add emphasis and visual badges to choice options on choose_path screen highlighting instant play vs custom pet path.
   config: {"choose_path": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Instant Play", "style": "emphasis"}, {"type": "badge", "text": "AI Custom Creation", "style": "playful"}]}}
8: [sign_in, notification] Sign-in progress notification indicator: Add a progress bar and sync confirmation hint to sign_in to reassure users their pet configuration is safe.
   config: {"sign_in": {"show_progress": true, "hint": "Your pet progress is saved. Complete sign in to finish setup."}}
9: [sign_in, reorder] Move sign-in after photo upload step: Reorder the sign-in step to appear immediately after pet photo upload instead of before pet creation.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "sign_in", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "sign_in": {"headline": "Save Your Photo Creation", "body": "Sign in now to generate and protect your custom pet."}}

verdicts.reason: Redesign keeps photo upload functionality within onboarding rules.
Adding a new mascot greeting screen before home_intro is allowed.
Story screen redesign retains the job of introducing the pet companion.
Waiting screen enhancement retains indication that the pet is being generated.
Copy update clearly explains account backup without violating pricing or fair design rules.
Adoption certificate retains official verification badge and adds progress indicators.
Adding interactive hints to home_intro is valid within onboarding.
Feature badges highlight options while retaining both adoption and custom creation paths.
Sign-in progress indicator and hint maintain fair design standards.
Reordering sign-in after photo upload is explicitly permitted by onboarding rules.
